description:
**Role Name \-** 
 AI \& Computer Vision Engineer

**Location \-** 
 Sector 132, Noida
   

  

**About ZOID**
 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup working on advanced technologies for the defence and aerospace sector. We build customised solutions for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers, with our strength being hands\-on expertise in AI, electronics, UAVs and robotics.
   

  

**Current Projects Include**
* AI\-based FOD detection software for naval air stations
* Reusable Off\-board Missile Decoy for anti\-ship missile defence
* GNSS\-Denied Navigation Suite
* Aerial Intelligent Mapping Suite
* Vision\-based Kinetic Strike Solution
* Swarming Solutions


**Role Brief**
 We are looking for an AI and Computer vision engineer to handle AI/computer\-vision data operations through field data collection, image annotation, dataset QC, and test\-set analysis for UAV/defence applications. The role involves working with field teams during runway/track tests and maintaining accurate, traceable datasets and test logs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the optics testing end to end (FOV, focal length and depth\-of\-field calculations) for detecting 3 x 3 x 3 mm objects.
* Plan and conduct optics testing including camera \& lens settings (focus, motion\-blur budget, exposure, gain, FPS, binning, etc).
* Build and manage the dataset, annotation and QA/QC rules, data versioning, and backup (Raid Configuration).
* Analyse the type of datasets which should be collected for any specific task.
* Develop the detection \& classification model for millimetre\-scale objects at high resolution.
* Optimise models for real\-time inference on the GPU servers such that multiple cameras can simultaneously operate on a single GPU without any accuracy loss.
* Implement object localisation and geo\-referencing of detections using RTK/GNSS and frame timestamps and validate CEP in the field.
* Maintain a model registry with regression tests so no release degrades detection performance; run the false\-positive review loop with operations staff.
* Analyse why false positives are occurring and how to eliminate them?
* Recommend computation hardware (GPU, memory, storage, camera network cards) based on model and data\-rate requirements.
* Apply AI methods to 3D photogrammetry data. Run segmentation, object detection and change detection, and extend the 3D processing pipeline where required. (Good to have)


**Must Have**
* Fluency in Python.
* Strong computer vision fundamentals
* Knowledge of PyTorch \& implementation of object detection at high resolution and small object scale (YOLO/DETR family or equivalent).
* Dataset engineering: annotation tooling (CVAT/Label Studio), QC methods, data versioning (DVC), experiment tracking (W\&B/MLflow).
* TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX, INT8 quantisation, multi\-GPU inference.
* Optics knowledge: FOV, IFOV, GSD, focal length, MTF, exposure \& experience with machine\-vision cameras and NIR imaging (Good to have)
* Object localisation and geo\-referencing: pixel\-to\-ground mapping, CEP estimation, working with RTK/GNSS and time\-synchronised frames. (Good to have)
* 3D data handling: point clouds and meshes (Open3D, PCL, PDAL or equivalent), knowledge of 3D deep learning models (PointNet/PointNet\+\+, KPConv or similar) for segmentation and detection on 3D models. (Good to have)
* Linux, Git and CI; comfortable deploying and debugging on field hardware.


**Good To Have**
* Experience with multi\-camera systems: synchronisation, overlapping fields of view, and stitching or fusing outputs from a camera array.
* Familiarity with GigE\-Vision/GenICam camera SDKs and PoE camera networks, enough to debug frame drops and timing with the software team.
* Active learning or semi\-automatic labelling to cut annotation effort on large field datasets.
* Exposure to anomaly detection or unsupervised methods for finding objects that were never in the training set.
* LiDAR or depth\-sensor data handling, useful for cross\-checking optical detections and for AIMS 3D work.
* Understanding of EO/IR sensor behaviour beyond NIR (SWIR/MWIR), for future sensor upgrades.
* Basic Docker and model\-serving experience for reproducible field deployments.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
You'll be the person who makes our AI agents sound right — and convert. At JoyzAI, that means owning the prompts and conversation design behind every client's AI calling agent and chatbot: how the agent opens a call, how it qualifies a lead, how it handles "I'm busy, call me later," how it declines a question it shouldn't answer, and how it does all of that in the client's voice, in English or Hinglish.
 



 This is not a prompt\-tweaking role. It's a design\-and\-own role. You write the prompt, you listen to the calls it produced, you find where it broke, and you fix it — for real clients, in production, with real leads on the other end of the line.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





**Prompt \& conversation design** 



* Translate each client's business requirements into prompt strategies, conversation flows, and guardrails for their AI calling agent and chatbot.
* Design voice\-first conversations — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, objection handling, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and handoffs to WhatsApp for links and addresses.
* Build and maintain the prompts behind core workflows: lead qualification, FAQs, appointment booking, and follow\-up sequences.
* Nail tone and persona for each client, including Hinglish where their customers speak it.



  





**Testing \& optimisation** 



* Read call transcripts and chat logs every day. Catch the weak answers, the hallucinations, the places the agent talks too much or asks two questions at once.
* Run structured experiments — A/B prompt variants, regression test sets, edge\-case scripts — and measure what actually moved: qualification rate, drop\-offs, escalations, wrong answers.
* Ship prompt improvements fast and safely, without breaking what was already working.
* Document prompt frameworks and reusable templates so the next client's agent starts from a better baseline than the last.



  





**Clients \& the team** 



* Sit in on kickoffs and go\-lives with customer success to understand how the client's sales process actually works before you write a word.
* Work with engineering on what the platform needs — new behaviours, better tooling for testing prompts, model changes.
* Feed what you learn from the logs back to product and sales so the whole company gets smarter about what works on a call.



  





  





 Roughly 70% of your time is hands\-on: writing and testing prompts, reading transcripts, running experiments. The other 30% is with clients and the team — understanding the business behind the agent and figuring out what a better conversation is worth to them. Expect that balance to shift toward the thinking as our testing tooling matures.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 Two things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet both — they're the first thing we screen for.
 


* **You've worked at a Voice AI company.** 
 Professionally, on AI voice agents or conversational voice products. You know what makes a voice conversation actually work: turn\-taking, interruptions, latency, STT/TTS quirks, keeping the agent on track without it sounding robotic.
* **You've built AI agents for clients, not for yourself.** 
 You've taken a client's requirements, shipped an agent their real customers talked to, and iterated on it using live conversation data. Personal projects, hackathon demos, and coursework don't count.



  





 Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
 


* Design prompts and script conversations that hold up under systematic testing, not just in the happy path.
* Work comfortably with LLMs and conversational AI platforms, with a basic grasp of NLP concepts.
* Read analytics and transcripts and turn them into concrete prompt changes with measurable results.
* Write clearly and concisely for business and customer\-facing communication, with a good ear for tone and context.
* Gather requirements from PMs, engineers, sales, and clients, and iterate quickly without waiting to be told.
* Think in a structured way, sweat the details, and document what you did so others can build on it.



  





 Nice to have: experience with sales tech, CRM systems, or customer support automation.
 



  





 Full\-time, on\-site in Noida.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨ Top\-of\-the\-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨ 5\-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨ High\-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.
